title: Chapter 1118
paragraphs: Chapter 1118
Episode 258. The Predator of All Dimensions (8)
A dimensional gate formed from sun energy. From within, other egos of the Sun God were emerging.
Iloanu, the ego of reconstruction, and Araxion, the ego of destruction. Both egos had taken a Runcandel, or one who was once a Runcandel, as their host.
[Iloanu!? And Araxion too...!]
Bligiet shouted. With Malugia and Kragos already in a temporary alliance, it was highly likely that they too had come here to fight against Kelliark.
The problem was that they hadn't come alone.
[Lokia...!]
Lucy's face contorted. Lokia Ganesto, and her entire family, had also appeared on the battlefield, riding through the dimensional gates of the Sun God's egos.
"Ah, don't look at me so hatefully. It's not like we came here because we wanted to. Can you let me in for a moment?"
Lokia spoke, looking up precisely at Lucy's screen as if she knew the internal layout of Lafrarosa.
[Get lost!]
"If you're uncomfortable letting me on board, it's not a bad idea for you to come out either. We're inside the shield anyway. It'd be nice to see your daughter's face after a long time, too."

At the mention of Haylin, Lucy's eyes wavered. Her daughter, whom she had lost once a thousand years ago and given up on a little while ago, was staring at the Genesis Knights' battlefield, her whole body wrapped in intense sun energy.
She wanted to scream and vent her hatred.
But Lucy soon calmed her excitement. No matter how terrible it was, now was not the time to be swayed by personal feelings.
[...I'll come out.]
As Lucy came out of the bridge with her comrades, she flinched at the sight of Lokia.
A wrinkled face with no trace of youth, a sight that hadn't been visible on the screen inside the bridge.
"You really are too nice, Lucy. You should have laughed at me, not just been surprised by my appearance, don't you think?"
[Shut up and just state your business.]
"My business..."
At those words, Lokia was silent for a few seconds as if lost in thought. In the meantime, Lucy looked at her daughter standing next to her.
She had the same face as when Myu was about seventeen. But her whole body shone with sun energy, and in her eyes, only the empty instinct of ruin shimmered.
"Well, I'm not so sure anymore. Why I'm doing all this."
Lokia had sacrificed practically everything to grasp the situation in the Black Sea.

She had used the countless worlds of her own creation to reproduce a situation similar to the present one. Her aged body was the price for repeating that process. When all the reproductions were finished, Lokia had reached the conclusion that she had to find her way to the battlefield, no matter what.
Because Jin must not die now. If he did, then in the end, not only the Ganestos but no one would be able to obtain Solderet's final legacy.
"From my perspective, the plan has gone too far awry. So it's hard to define my business in a single phrase. However, let's just say it's certain that I came to help you all."
[What did you say?]
"The Zipples. I hate them too."
[How can we trust you?]
"What can you do if you don't trust me? Dragon Sword Lucy Runcandel."
Lucy couldn't answer.

At any other time, she could have handled Lokia even if she had brought two of the Sun God's egos. In the first place, if Kelliark hadn't been here, the Coalition would have been strong enough to win even against the Demon Army. But now, the moment Lokia began to attack the Coalition, the already difficult war situation would plummet into an abyss.

"What can you do, you lucky soul, who can console yourself by saying you've made a beautiful choice just by standing still? Can you add a force that can be of immediate help in battle, like me? Or can you help to release Hairan's curse more quickly?"
Having Araxion and Iloanu join the battle, and speeding up the release of Hairan's curse. These were the things Lokia was about to do now.
Lucy gritted her teeth and glared at Lokia. Lokia, unconcerned by her gaze, extended a hand to her first knight who was awaiting orders.
Joshua Runcandel. He had obtained the power of Iloanu through Lokia.
"Joshua, my most loyal knight. Go and strike Kelliark Zipfel. Even if your whole body is shattered to pieces, and even your soul is completely torn to become a handful of dust... for the family."
[Of course I will, Mother.]
Joshua, kneeling on one knee, kissed the back of Lokia's hand. Lokia looked into Joshua's eyes for a while.
Even though only a sacrilegious and miserable fight awaited him now, there was no hesitation in his eyes.
"...You now seem to understand me a little, Joshua."
[With that, I can accept my entire life.]
Lokia stroked Joshua's hair once, then turned her gaze to Lucy.
"Lucy, shouldn't you say a word to your daughter too? Now that she's heading to the battlefield, Haylin will surely never be able to return."
Her teeth chattered. Haylin, unlike Joshua, seemed to have no human consciousness at all.
Nevertheless, she had no choice but to follow Lokia's words. As a mother who had always lost and given up on her daughter, there was something she had to say. Even if Haylin couldn't hear it.
[I'm sorry, Haylin. If there is a next time, you must live happily under better parents. You must live with only as much pain and happiness as a person can bear.]
She couldn't bring herself to cry. Lucy, with a calm expression, reached out to touch Haylin's shoulder, the face she had wanted to see so much, then withdrew her hand. Haylin had no reaction.
[Mother, we will go too.]
Ran, Vyugo, Myu, and Anne. The remaining knights of Ganesto were also drawing their swords. Lokia knew better than anyone that they could not be of significant help in this war.
"Yes, you too need a moment to become a flame. Even if it's a dirty flame that can't move anyone. Go and let it bloom. I, at least, will not deny you."
The knights of Ganesto and Araxion began to run towards the battlefield.

Joshua, who had obtained the power of Iloanu, and Araxion rushed towards the battlefield, pushing back the enemies without hesitation, but the remaining knights showed signs of struggling as soon as they left Lafrarosa's shield.
[Kuaaargh...!]

Their limbs were torn by the magic of the Demon Army's Genesis Knights, and when they regenerated and stood up again, the swords of the Coalition members stabbed them. The situation hadn't been fully communicated yet, so to the Coalition members, the Ganesto knights were just enemies who had appeared like cockroaches at this very moment. It would probably be the same even after the communication was complete.
[We have come under our mother's orders to support you!]
No Coalition member answered their shouts. Not only did they not have the leisure to do so, but as enemies or allies, they were not beings who could create any particular turn in the battle.

"It's an interesting thing. In the end, those children are fighting for Runcandel now. Although their intention is for me, not Runcandel, and no one welcomes those children. On the contrary, they curse, spit, and stab their bodies with knives."

[You are a terrible person. No, you're not even a person. You said you would help us, but in your head, there's probably nothing but the thought of somehow taking Temar's left arm, even at this moment.]
"It would seem so. But this is what it means to be bound, Lucy. It makes a person pathetic. Now then, I should get to my work."
Lokia raised both her arms.

"I can help with the curse removal as long as I can use a minimal amount of magic. The great serpent Ameris must be undoing it inside Lafrarosa, right? I doubt you'll just let me into the bridge, so go ahead and restrain me."
{[Lucy, don't restrain her, just bring her in.]}
It was Lueth, who had been watching the situation on the screen inside the ship.
"Oh, Lueth."
[Chief Butler, will this be alright?]

{[We don't have the capacity to restrain her right now anyway. She said that knowing this. She will surely try to backstab us at a critical moment, but that's better. Better than enduring that monster for seventeen hours. Not restraining her will also be slightly more efficient for the curse removal.]}

"As expected, the Chief Butler is quick to grasp reality. Seventeen hours? Against the leader of the Demon Army? And now the Origin Stone will soon arrive on the battlefield, so even if there was one more Chiron and Vahn here, it would be impossible. The same goes for if Temar from that era were here."
The lower entrance of Lafrarosa opened. Lucy, following Lueth's words, re-entered the ship with Lokia.
Lueth personally guided Lokia to Ameris's workshop. Ameris was so focused on the curse removal that she didn't even notice the workshop door opening and people entering.

"Lueth, it's been a long time since I've seen you this close. How many of the Runcandels from that era are gathered on this battlefield? Me, you, Lucy, Murakan, Bale, and if we count Temar, who is only a left arm here, as one, that makes six. It's enough to bring tears to my eyes thinking of the old days."
[How much can you speed up the curse removal?]
"Let me take a look. Hmm... at this rate, I can speed it up by at least ten hours. Still, an ancient god is an ancient god. To understand Melka's curse this much is a little surprising."
[Speak in terms of the maximum, not the minimum.]

"Then let's say twelve hours. But that's only if Kelliark Zipfel's attacks have no effect on this workshop. Even assuming twelve hours, we still have to endure for five hours. You should be more worried about that. Even with Iloanu and Araxion joining, it's still a hopeless situation. You saw Kragos get torn apart in one go, right? I think those two are stronger than him, but."
While talking with Lokia, Lueth was looking at the crucible through the recording screen. She could see Kragos being pushed back and Jin struggling to protect Valeria and Enya.

Lokia glanced at the screen and inwardly let out a hollow laugh. It was just funny that at this point, when she herself had thrown everything away to come and release the curse on Temar's left arm, Jin was in danger of losing his left arm.

"It's truly strange, how fate, which wouldn't smile no matter how hard I tried... fits together perfectly for someone else like a predetermined puzzle. I need to focus now. Try to handle the leader of the Demon Army well on your own."
Soon, Lueth and Lucy left the workshop.

[Lucy, go and bring Lord Talaris. Whatever happens inside, we must place an absolute seal on this place with the power of the Secret Palace. Also, even if Kelliark's attacks start to hit Lafrarosa directly, only she can create a seal that can block the impact that will be transmitted here to some extent.]
